\section{Symmetric junction}
For the symmetric junction, with $\Gamma_R = \Gamma_L$, the transmission reaches one on resonance,
\begin{equation}
\frac{4\Gamma_L\Gamma_R}{(\Gamma_L+\Gamma_R)^2} = 1 .
\label{eq:sym}
\end{equation}
\section{Asymmetric junction}
For $\Gamma_R \neq \Gamma_L$ the peak transmission is reduced by the coupling asymmetry,
\begin{equation}
\frac{4\Gamma_L\Gamma_R}{(\Gamma_L+\Gamma_R)^2} = 1 - \frac{\Gamma_L-\Gamma_R}{\Gamma_L+\Gamma_R} .
\label{eq:asym}
\end{equation}
